Dr. Adaeze Marguerite Okonkwo-Lindqvist

Clinical informatics researcher, standards editor, and program advisor

Rotterdam, Netherlands a.okonkwo-lindqvist@example.org +31 10 555 0142 example.org/profiles/okonkwo-lindqvist

Profile

Researcher and program advisor working where clinical evidence, data standards, and public-sector delivery meet. Leads multi-country interoperability programs, edits open specifications, and teaches evidence appraisal to clinical and engineering teams.

Appointments

Commonwealth Advisory Council on Digital Health Infrastructure and Cross-Border Clinical Data Exchange

Principal Scientific Advisor, Interoperability Working Group Chair

September 2021 - Present

  • Chaired a 14-member working group that consolidated three incompatible referral-message profiles into one published specification.
  • Designed an evidence register linking every normative requirement to its source study, pilot finding, or regulatory citation.
  • Negotiated pilot terms with six regional health authorities, including data-protection impact assessments and exit criteria.
Focus areas:
  • Referral messaging
  • Terminology binding
  • Consent provenance
  • Evidence traceability
  • Public-sector procurement

Erasmus Institute for Health Systems Research

Senior Research Fellow
